summary: Frontend-only testing for the new /asien Asia listing page. All 12 features from the review request passed at both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) viewports. Hero title/CTA/subtitle, trust bar strings, sticky sub-nav labels, Länder dropdown (14 items, outside-click closes), Reiseführer/Inspiration non-navigating, intro heading + bold spans, tours grid (6 initial, 18 expanded, collapses back to 6, cards do not navigate), countries row (14 items), Wohin toggle (1<->4), continents row (11 items), 3 USPs, and zero console errors/warnings/duplicate keys. Regression: hero-search 'Asia' suggestion navigates to /asien and 'Egypt' still navigates to /afrika/aegypten.
critical_code_review_comments: AsiaListing.jsx uses <b key={i}> on inline bold spans within intro.text.map — keys are unique (index-based) and no React duplicate-key warnings surfaced. OK.
All tile/dropdown/CTA anchors correctly call e.preventDefault() so href='#' does not cause navigation. Verified via URL diff after clicks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: /asien route is fully functional. Verified counts: products=18 (6 initial), countries=14, continents=11, wohin=4, usps=3, Länder dropdown=14. No console errors. Regression search suggestions for Asia and Egypt both work.
